Name: Cat to Monster - Monster Pets
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][color=#ff00ff][u][i]Monster Pets[/i][/u][/color][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Replace the cat (the orange one) with one of the mine monsters of your choice and enjoy an unusual relationship, without violence or prejudice. You will adopt a cute Shadow Girl or an elegant flying Serpent, or... A stone with legs?[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][u][b]
[i]This mod contains:[/i]
[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Most of the monsters in the mines ([b]See below[/b]). For now only the normal monsters and not their deep mine variations.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]New animations for all monsters including [b]Sleeping[/b] or Special animations to replace the cat licking.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A option ([b]Disabled by default[/b]) to replace the cat's sounds with the corresponding of the monster you have chosen.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]New sounds for monsters such as Pepper Rex, skeleton or spider, which do not have their own in-game sounds.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=4][b][i]Naturally, this is a change of appearance and they will NOT HAVE unique behaviors, apart from the new animations mentioned above.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]

[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]

[/size][size=5][b][i][color=#00ffff][u]Actual Monsters:[/u][/color][/i]
[/b][/size]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Big Slime (All Game Colors)[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Blue Squid[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Bug[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Duggy[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Dust Spirit[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Fly[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Ghost[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Green Slime (And All Game Colors)[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Grub[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Haunted Skull[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Magma Sprite[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Metal Head[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Mummy[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Pepper Rex[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Rock Crab[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Serpent[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Shadow Brute[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Shadow Girl[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Skeleton[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Spider[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Squid Kid[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][color=#00ff00][font=Georgia][size=5][b][u]
[i]
Instructions:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/font][/color][left][font=Georgia][size=4]Use '[/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]' to configure this mod more easily and to be able to see a description of what each option does.[/size][/font][/left][font=Georgia]

[color=#ff0000][size=6][b][u][i]Important Note:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]If you have any bugs of any kind do not hesitate to report them, maybe the monsters have a glitchy animation or [b][color=#ffff00]the sounds are too loud[/color][/b].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The animations are limited by the game so some of them can look very strange at times. No special sounds can be added to the monsters or change the sounds of their footsteps, as this same sound is reused several times within the game.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=4][b][i]It is quite possible that there will be no animations for Dogs due to their change in behavior.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list]
